goal: Harrison Beach Hotel is already ahead of most of the properties we work with. The schema is in place, the FAQ page is live, the landing pages have been refreshed, and ChatGPT puts the hotel in its top three places to stay in Harrison and at number one for meetings. The assessment scored the booking experience at 99 out of 100 and the reputation at 4.4 stars across 895 Google reviews. What the numbers also show is where the money is leaking: OTA bookings crept from a historic 20 percent to about 30 percent in August and September, and a social following of 23,206 is producing 0.34 percent engagement and almost no comments. The next ninety days are about closing both gaps. The first is a topic cluster content hub that makes Harrison Beach Hotel the most specific, most citable answer to the questions travellers put to AI tools, ahead of Expedia and Booking.com. The second is a high-volume social system, built on a bank of pillar content that your coordinator, Nicole, and Megan can keep full, that turns an audience you already have into direct bookings. The third is the conversion layer that connects the two: direct-booking perks that are impossible to miss, packages with your partners, midweek and shoulder season campaigns, and a proper push on the meetings and events business. The target is simple to state and measurable every month: direct bookings back toward 80 percent, fewer empty midweek nights, and more meeting enquiries.
